measure.measure_definition: Measured value: change in NRS pain intensity score from baseline (T0) to post-intervention (T1); Participants; Numeric Rating Scale (NRS; 0–10) assessed at baseline T0 and post-intervention after two weeks T1; change from T0 to T1.; NRS range 0–10. Change is calculated from T0 to T1. Internal responsiveness was evaluated using the distribution-based standardized mean difference (SMD), reported with 95% CI.

Measured value: change in ODI disability score from baseline (T0) to post-intervention (T1); Participants; Oswestry Disability Index (ODI; 0–100%) assessed at baseline T0 and post-intervention after two weeks T1; change from T0 to T1.; ODI range 0–100%. Change is calculated from T0 to T1. Internal responsiveness was evaluated using the distribution-based standardized mean difference (SMD), reported with 95% CI.

Measured value: change in RMDQ score from baseline (T0) to post-intervention (T1); Participants; Roland–Morris Disability Questionnaire (RMDQ; 0–24) assessed at baseline T0 and post-intervention after two weeks T1; change from T0 to T1.; RMDQ range 0–24. Change is calculated from T0 to T1. Internal responsiveness was evaluated using the distribution-based standardized mean difference (SMD), reported with 95% CI.

population.intervention: Osteopathic manipulative treatment (OMT) combined with transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS); sham procedures were applied in the placebo condition.
population.intervention_regimen: Active condition: tDCS 2 mA for 20 minutes; OMT dose Not reported. Placebo condition: sham procedures.; Planned: tDCS for 20 minutes over two weeks targeting the primary motor cortex; OMT delivered in two sessions using individualized techniques; sham procedures for placebo. Assessments at baseline T0, post-intervention after two weeks T1, and follow-up one month after treatment completion T2.
population.population_definition: Analysis set: participants pooled across the active and placebo conditions after the original three-arm trial was collapsed into two conditions; restricted to complete T0, T1 and T2 data.; Adults aged 18–55 years diagnosed with chronic non-specific low back pain (pain duration ≥12 weeks), recruited from the original randomized controlled trial; only participants with complete data across all assessment time points (T0, T1, and T2) were included in this analysis. The pooled cohort comprised 38 active-group and 39 placebo-group participants.
population.population_time_frame: Recruited May 2022–July 2023; baseline T0, post-intervention after two weeks T1, and follow-up one month after treatment completion T2.
